During the [[New Republic Era]], the [[Ithorian]] Misses [[Ikk]] from [[At Attin]] possessed a '''frogdog''' whom she would take for walks as part of her morning routine. A member of the loyal and attentive [[At Attin frogdog|At Attin subspecies]] of the [[frog-dog]], the individual was kept on a leash and tended to bark at noisy passers-by and invading [[pirate]] [[frigate]]s.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Sorry, Misses Ikk!|Wim to Misses Ikk|<ref name="SC 101" />|audio=Sorry-Ikk.mp3}}
A member of the loyal and attentive [[At Attin frogdog|At Attin subspecies]] of the [[frog-dog]],<ref name="At Attin frogdog">{{Databank|at-attin-frogdog|At Attin frogdog}}</ref> the individual belonged to the [[Ithorian]] [[At Attin]] dweller, Misses [[Ikk]], who resided in the suburbs during the [[New Republic Era]]. The [[Gender|woman]] would take<ref name="SC 101" /> her<ref name="SC 101 AD" /> pet on morning walks, keeping<ref name="SC 101" /> him<ref name="SC 101 AD" /> on a leash as she strolled among the neighboring households.<ref name="SC 101" />

Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> Ikk and her frogdog were passing by [[Wim's home]] when the boy [[Wim]] suddenly rushed out of<ref name="SC 101" /> his<ref name="SC 101 AD" /> garage. With a toy in his [[Limb|hand]], he leaped over a [[lawnmower]] being pushed by a [[maintenance droid]] before he got closer to the dog,<ref name="SC 101" /> mimicking [[starship]] whooshing<ref name="SC 101 ST">{{SkeletonCrew|This Could Be a Real Adventure}} {{Subtitles|Disney+}}</ref> as he moved the toy around in the [[Atmosphere|air]]. Startled by the boy, Misses Ikk's frogdog barked at him, intruding on a neighbor's lawn. When Ikk rebuked the [[youngling]] in her native [[Ithorese]], Wim called out an apology from a distance as he hurried off to catch his [[school tram]].<ref name="SC 101" />

[[File:BarkingFrogDog-SC1.png|thumb|right|Misses Ikk's frogdog startled by Wim]]
On the following day, the frogdog kept his owner company on another walk. Just as the pair passed by Wim's domicile, Wim left his house's garage on his [[Wim's hoverbike|hoverbike]], splashing [[Water|rainwater]]<ref name="SC 101" /> as he careened unsteadily down the road.<ref name="SC 101 AD" /> Misses Ikk's frogdog barked at the boy, walking onto the streetway as the youngling moved away.<ref name="SC 101" />

Some [[time]] later, At Attin was [[Invasion of At Attin|invaded]] by [[Silvo's pirates]].<ref name="SC 108" /> Silvo posed a [[Galactic Republic]] emissary arriving to collect Old Republic [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] which the population of At Attin produced in mints and stowed in underground vaults.<ref name="SC 107">{{SkeletonCrew|We're Gonna Be In So Much Trouble}}</ref> As an alleged emissary, the [[pirate]] was granted an audience with [[the Supervisor]], a [[droid]]<ref name="SC 108" /> responsible for overseeing the [[Great Work]]<ref name="SC 101" /> of credit production. When Silvo destroyed the Supervisor to subordinate the At Attin citizens to himself, the [[planet]] was hit by a power outage. Suddenly, a [[Silvo's pirate frigate|pirate frigate]] emerged in the dark sky.<ref name="SC 108" /> As the invading [[starship]] set its [[superlaser]] [[cannon]]s in battle-ready position, the frogdog happened to be on a walk with his owner Ikk.<ref name="SC 108 AD">{{SkeletonCrew|The Real Good Guys}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> Looking up, the pet barked at the invaders before they launched a massive bombardment. Separated from her pet, Misses Ikk was captured by the pirates and walked away alongside other rounded-up citizens until<ref name="SC 108" /> the [[Skeleton Crew]]<ref name="T19XifsgFS0">{{SWYouTube|T19XifsgFS0|Skeleton Crew | Blast from the Past | Streaming Dec 2 on Disney+}}</ref> and their [[parent]]s managed to contact the [[New Republic]] and disable the [[Barrier]] that kept At Attin isolated from the rest of [[the galaxy]]. When a New Republic [[squadron]] repelled the pirate invasion, power was gradually restored as the lights began to flicker back on.<ref name="SC 108" />

==Personality and traits==
Ikk's pet was a [[Color|brown]]-skinned At Attin frogdog with a pair of prominent black [[eye]]s and small [[ear]]holes right behind them. He was a quadruped, with three toes facing forward and one pointing backward on each foot. In addition, he had long, white teeth. A pet walked on a leash by his owner, the frogdog tended to bark at noisy passers-by<ref name="SC 101" /> and unfamiliar starship invading his planet.<ref name="SC 108" />

==Behind the scenes==
Misses Ikk's frogdog debuted in the first episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', "[[This Could Be a Real Adventure]],"<ref name="SC 101" /> which aired on [[December 2]] [[2024]].<ref name="Premiere">{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}}</ref> Additionally, the pet's [[Wikipedia:Grammatical person|third-person]] [[Wikipedia:Personal pronoun|pronouns]] were specified in the [[Disney+]] audio description of the episode, narrated by [[Jedediah Barton]].<ref name="SC 101 AD" /> Before the premiere, he was first pictured in a trailer of the series released on [[August 9]], [[2024]].<ref name="a6voXgBlmpk">{{SWYouTube|a6voXgBlmpk|Skeleton Crew | Official Trailer | Streaming December 3 on Disney+}}</ref>
